## D — Accuracy notes and source flags for licensing and testing
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; no fact relies on outside knowledge.
Dynamic service details: office hours and online appointment booking change over time and are isolated as dynamic facts; they must not be presented as permanent rules [A01].
Wording flag: the commercial Class C list joins its two descriptions with and, yet introduces them as any of the following; the dossier states them as alternatives, which matches the any-of lead-in [A04] (verify NC-LIC-D-CLASSC).
Road-test exceptions: the handbook says some cases may not require the road test but does not list them here, so no exception is stated as a rule [A03].
Exam numbers: no question count, passing score or time limit is printed in the handbook; none is stated anywhere in this dossier [A02].
Weight thresholds such as 26,001 and 10,001 pounds are copied exactly as printed and must not be rounded [A03].

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
